articles.title: Lions and tigers are kept legally in Ontario backyards. No one knows how many there are
articles.summary: Lions and tigers are kept legally in Ontario backyards. No one knows how many there are. Lions and tigers are among some of the most recognizable and dangerous predators in the world. They're also legal to own in Ontario, where provincial authorities can't say how many are being held in private cages and backyards.
